author: Tarheelkiwi
body:
I know that Avicus is having an update thing at 3pm ETS but i just wanted to say HAPPY BIRTHDAY AVICUS!!!!!!!!!!



Also, I just wanted to say, thank you for all the staff members who help make this server the best server I have ever played on.  Yes there are many problems that rose, but I believe that those problems help us unite together and stand strong.  Now lets take a moment to think about those retired (and current) staff members... THANK YOU!!!!!!!!
